properties.displayName: UAV S24 - Datalink C2 Channel Takeover (Rogue PeerIp + TxBytes Anomaly)
properties.description: C2_Whitelisted_GCS_List 외부 PeerIp가 MAVLink 포트에 연결하고 동시에 TxBytes z-score 이상 탐지. MITRE: T1090 Proxy, T1571 Non-Standard Port
properties.query:
let knownPorts = dynamic([5760, 5790, 14550, 14551]);
let alertWindow = 10m;
let KnownGCS = _GetWatchlist('C2_Whitelisted_GCS_List') | project GCS_IP;
let UnknownConn =
    UAVDatalinkConn_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | join kind=leftanti (KnownGCS) on $left.PeerIp == $right.GCS_IP
    | where LocalPort in (knownPorts)
    | project T_conn=TimeGenerated, UAVId, PeerIp, LocalPort, State;
let TxAnomaly =
    UAVDatalink_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
    | make-series AvgTx=avg(TxBytes) on TimeGenerated step 5m by UAVId
    | extend (Anom, Score, Base) = series_decompose_anomalies(AvgTx, 3.0)
    | mv-expand TimeGenerated, AvgTx=todouble(AvgTx), Anom=toint(Anom)
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow) and Anom == 1
    | project T_tx=TimeGenerated, UAVId, AvgTx;
UnknownConn
| join kind=inner (TxAnomaly) on UAVId
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    State == 'ESTABLISHED', strcat("비인가IP_C2포트_연결수립_TxBurst_", PeerIp),
    strcat("비인가IP_C2포트_연결시도_TxBurst_", PeerIp))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project T_conn, UAVId, PeerIp, LocalPort, AvgTx, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by T_conn desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S24 - Datalink C2 Channel Takeover (Rogue PeerIp + TxBytes Anomaly) - {{PeerIp}}
